scripts.check: npm run build && npm run build:tui
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run check:experiments
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:tui && node scripts/run-node-tests.mjs
scripts.tauri:build: npm run tauri:prepare-node && npm run build && node scripts/run-tauri.mjs build
scripts.tauri:dist: npm run tauri:prepare-node && npm run build && node scripts/tauri-build-dist.mjs
scripts.tauri:dev: npm run tauri:prepare-node && npm run build && node scripts/run-tauri.mjs dev
scripts.dev: npm run build && sh -c 'tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput & tsc_pid=$!; trap "kill $tsc_pid 2>/dev/null" EXIT; WEBUI_DEV_RELOAD=1 node --watch --watch-path=dist/web/src/server dist/web/src/server/main.js "$@"' --
